name: Parrot: AI Phonetics Coach
tagline: Pronunciation training with per-sound feedback, lip tracking and AI-generated practice sentences.
problem: Learners get little precise feedback on pronunciation.
solution: Speech assessment scores accuracy, fluency and intonation by sound, face-mesh lip tracking guides mouth shape, and Gemini generates targeted sentences.
demo_moment: Team-described: record a sentence and see sound-level scores.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 112 submissions.
Feedback down to the individual sound.
